serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy is going through some serious shit right now…
He’s kinda defensive about this whole stuff with his wife and I can’t really blame him. 
All I can do for him is to listen and offer a good word, because I’m in no place to give him any advice. Let’s be honest, my life is a wreck.
All I do is sit around in my flat and talk with bot. I wish I could change things around, but what if I’m not up to the job and it all fails?
I need to think about it a little more…
